Who We Are

A Nagpur & Gondia studio for celebrations that feel like you.

Velora Events plans and styles weddings, sangeets, birthdays and personal celebrations from first idea to final tear-down — décor, mandap and stage design, vendor coordination, and on-ground execution, handled as one team so you can stay present in the moment.
